items.title: LabLLM
items.summary: A native macOS lab for teaching tiny language models to think — build the architecture, train the weights, and watch a small LLM emerge from scratch, locally on Apple Silicon with custom data, tokenizers, checkpoints, and MLX acceleration.
items.summary_cn: 一个原生的macOS实验室，用于教授微型语言模型思考--构建架构、训练权重，并从头开始观看小型LLM ，本地在Apple Silicon上使用自定义数据、令牌生成器、检查点和MLX加速。
items.comment: AI 模型迭代快得飞起，有几个真正解决了实际问题？等落地案例。

items.title: neurocursor-ai

This study proposes a three-agent workflow integrating conversational data collection, structured data processing, and behavioral prediction...

items.summary: Naturalistic computer-use traces, passively recorded screenshots and mouse or keyboard actions, are a valuable resource for deriving symbolic, auditable, and reusable models of how everyday work is done. Such models matter as computer-use agents enter real work, where agents need to learn how tasks ...
